metadata.question: Does the snow cover in southern Siberia increase between October 14, 2018 and October 29, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS daily snow cover product (MOD10A1.006 or MODIS/006/MOD10A1) which provides daily snow cover data. Southern Siberia is a large region, so I'll define a representative polygon/area. The dates are October 14 and 29, 2018. 2. Masking: MODIS snow cover has a quality band (NDSI_Snow_Cover_Basic_QA), but the main band 'NDSI_Snow_Cover' already flags no-snow/cloud etc. I’ll use the 'NDSI_Snow_Cover' band, where values 0–100 mean snow cover percent, 200 = no snow, 201 = no decision, 237 = inland water, etc. I will mask out non-snow pixels (values >100). 3. Logic: - Get images for Oct 14 and Oct 29, 2018. - Mask clouds/inland water/other invalid pixels (values >100). - Compute mean snow cover % for the region on each date. - Compare the two means to see if snow cover increased. - If image collections are empty → C1. - If after masking zero pixels remain → C2. - Calc returns None/NaN/unrealistic → C3. - Else determine if increase → A (Yes) / B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry – southern Siberia polygon siberia = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[[91, 54], [91, 50], [110, 50], [110, 54], [91, 54]]], None, False) # 2. Data Acquisition col1 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1').filterBounds(siberia).filterDate('2018-10-14', '2018-10-15') col2 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1').filterBounds(siberia).filterDate('2018-10-29', '2018-10-30') if col1.size().getInfo() == 0 or col2.size().getInfo() == 0: print("One date has no images.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Processing: mask invalid pixels (snow % 0-100 only) def maskSnow(img): qa = img.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover') return qa.updateMask(qa.lte(100)) img1 = col1.map(maskSnow).first() img2 = col2.map(maskSnow).first() # 4. Calculation stats = img1.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=siberia, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) pct1 = stats.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo() stats2 = img2.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=siberia, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) pct2 = stats2.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo()) if pct1 is None or pct2 is None or any([str(p) == 'nan' for p in [pct1, pct2]]): print("Stats invalid.") print("C3") exit() # Count valid pixels for sanity check cnt1 = img1.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=siberia, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo() cnt2 = img2.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=siberia, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo() print(f"2018-10-14 mean snow: {pct1:.1f}%, Pixels: {cnt1}") print(f"2018-10-29 mean snow: {pct2:.1f}%, Pixels: {cnt2}") # Zero pixels after masking if cnt1 == 0 or cnt2 == 0: print("No valid pixels after masking.") print("C2") exit() # Determine change if pct2 > pct1: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry – southern Siberia polygon
siberia = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[[91, 54], [91, 50], [110, 50], [110, 54], [91, 54]]],
    None, False)

# 2. Data Acquisition
col1 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1').filterBounds(siberia).filterDate('2018-10-14', '2018-10-15')
col2 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1').filterBounds(siberia).filterDate('2018-10-29', '2018-10-30')

if col1.size().getInfo() == 0 or col2.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("One date has no images.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Processing: mask invalid pixels (snow % 0-100 only)
def maskSnow(img):
    qa = img.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover')
    return qa.updateMask(qa.lte(100))

img1 = col1.map(maskSnow).first()
img2 = col2.map(maskSnow).first()

# 4. Calculation
stats = img1.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=siberia, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)
pct1 = stats.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo()

stats2 = img2.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=siberia, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)
pct2 = stats2.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo())

if pct1 is None or pct2 is None or any([str(p) == 'nan' for p in [pct1, pct2]]):
    print("Stats invalid.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    exit()

# Count valid pixels for sanity check
cnt1 = img1.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=siberia, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo()
cnt2 = img2.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=siberia, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo()

print(f"2018-10-14 mean snow: {pct1:.1f}%, Pixels: {cnt1}")
print(f"2018-10-29 mean snow: {pct2:.1f}%, Pixels: {cnt2}")

# Zero pixels after masking
if cnt1 == 0 or cnt2 == 0:
    print("No valid pixels after masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

# Determine change
if pct2 > pct1:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
